parsed.explanation: Combined regime: the national framework imposes traveller-facing exposure at passport and entry (sex-marker restriction in force after November 2025; passports confiscated or blocked, stranding travellers; refusal on document discrepancy; fraud-ground lifetime-ineligibility risk). Federal custody records document forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse of trans detainees, and the corrections bureau has stopped reporting trans prisoners. The division adds birth-certificate marker foreclosure, a K-12 facility ban, a 2023 executive order reaching state-owned facilities and incarceration, and restricted state-funded care. Its state trespass-offence status is not documented. Against this, national hate-crime and employment protections exist, private care remains available, and no visitor-specific violence is documented. Remedies are litigated but not operating for visitors. The score sits near the severe-to-high boundary, with the documented custody and entry exposures outweighing the protective machinery.

entry_documents.exposure: Passport sex markers restricted to M/F per supporting documents since Feb 2025; Supreme Court allowed restrictions Nov 2025; passports confiscated or blocked, leaving travellers stranded. Entry cable directs refusal on document discrepancy and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X-marker passports valid to expiry; challenge by civil-liberties suit pending; fraud ineligibility is never automatic and has limited waivers.
entry_documents.interaction: Home-passport mismatch or doubt at processing feeds refusal, fraud allegation and possible detention, moving the traveller into the custody exposure below.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: documented forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of trans men. National corrections adopted conversion-therapy-style policies from 2026 and stopped reporting trans prisoner numbers.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Document discrepancy leads to detention, and custody placement follows the federal regime; the state trespass offence applies to state-owned buildings only.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Federal rules bar government-funded single-sex facilities by gender identity. The division's 2023 order extends birth-sex bathrooms and changing rooms to state-owned facilities, incarceration and shelters; K-12 facility ban applies. Trespass offence exists in some states; this state's status is not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Private-sector facilities are not covered by the state order as documented; no state visitor-facing protection on facilities is documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State-owned facility exclusion operates in the same public buildings the traveller uses; federal bans apply in parallel.

care_services.exposure: SB 904 bars public funds, Medicaid and state facilities from gender-affirming care for minors and adults; intentional violations by state employees are criminal. National subpoenas of hospital records for under-19 patients and proposed Medicaid rules add exposure.
care_services.protection: Care remains available at private facilities paid privately or by private insurance; emergency treatment to prevent death or major impairment is exempt; medications for other conditions exempt.
care_services.interaction: A visitor needing care must use private facilities or pay out of pocket, and the national subpoena regime can reach records.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy names 'radically pro-transgender' groups for priority neutralisation; executive orders direct investigation of schools and prosecution of teachers; state officials frame trans access as a rights threat.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Strategy disclaims targeting people who merely disagree; several orders are enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Federal threat framing can reach advocates and visible trans people, raising the stakes of any police contact.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minors face state and national care bans, school facility bans and athletics exclusion. A guardian travelling with a minor faces the same ban for school and government settings, and documents of the minor may be refused under the entry cable.
minors_guardians.protection: Emergency treatment exemption applies to minors; no minor-specific shield is documented.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor's document mismatch exposes the accompanying guardian to entry questioning and possible refusal.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No visitor-specific violence documented in the division; the cited violence concerns residents and students (2018 threats, 2024 case). National bias reporting is partial; 37 states lacked gender-identity anti-bias statutes as of 2019.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; 23 states cover it in state statutes; no state SOGI discrimination law, though one city covers all areas.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Recourse exists nationally but is thin in the state, and visitors have limited access to local protection.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: No working remedy for passport confiscation or custody abuse is documented. Driver's licence marker status, HB 1225 signature and SB 1141 outcome are unresolved; the state's 2026 risk grade is not stated.
remedies_unknowns.protection: National employment protection (2020 ruling) and hate-crime statute operate; national litigation on passports and orders is ongoing; the 2020 national employment ruling is in place.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedies depend on national courts and federal enforcement, which are themselves the source of several exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: Closest analogue: birth-sex bathroom rule in public buildings, no presentation offence, polite public, failed complaints. This case is similar in facility exclusion but adds documented federal custody sexual abuse, passport confiscation and stranding, and a lifetime-fraud entry risk, so it sits at or slightly below that anchor.

Birth-sex facility and ward rule with abuse and interrupted care, plus police stops and extortion. This case lacks documented police extortion or targeted stops of visitors and has ongoing litigation, so it sits modestly above that anchor.

Birth-sex public-building bathroom rule with no presentation offence and an unremedied exposure. This case adds federal custody abuse and passport-stranding exposure, which lifts risk, so it sits below that anchor.

parsed.synthesis: Traveller-facing exposures are cumulative: passport sex-marker restriction with confiscation and stranding, entry refusal and lifetime-fraud risk, federal immigration custody with documented abuse, and state-owned facility exclusion. Protections are limited to private-sector care, national hate-crime and employment law, and pending litigation that is not yet shown to change outcomes. Because the documented custody and entry exposures are federal and recurring, they are not offset by the division's narrower state rules or by the absence of a visitor-specific violence record.
